name: std::flat_multimap<Key,T,Compare,KeyContainer,MappedContainer>::clear
intro:
Erases all elements from the container adaptor. After this call, size() returns zero.

Invalidates any references, pointers, and iterators referring to contained elements.

sections.title: Complexity
sections.text: Linear in the size of the container adaptor, i.e., the number of elements.

summary: Erases all elements from the container adaptor. After this call, size() returns zero.
